Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis specifically compares unmodified RBCEVs against those covalently conjugated with the biotinylated TR5 peptide to identify the membrane proteins that serve as substrates for the ligase. While the broader study involves drug delivery (paclitaxel) and cancer cell treatments, the MS data described in the 'Biotin pulldown and mass spectrometry analysis' section is focused on the conjugation variable. Mapping is kept at the parent level 'chemical_or_drug' as the peptide is used as a chemical modification agent rather than a traditional inhibitor or activator.
